title: Three Harvests and One Short Song
subtitle: 可持续发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：harmony　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 harmony 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the village ① kept a harmony that no stranger in the valley would have described, and they said the keeping was the whole of the harvest. The ② harmony, meaning the peace itself and not the silence, ran three harvests and stayed undescribed in the book; a harmony, they said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of harmony in that valley had the same short song beside it, and the ④ harmony at the far field, meaning the tune they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A harmony, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the village said the describing is the part that fills three harvests.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the harmony was the whole of the matter, meaning the balance and not the peace. The ⑥ harmony, meaning the balance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; harmony, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a peace and a balance. He said the balance is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ harmony had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short song. The ⑧ harmony of the whole thing, the village wrote in November, was one valley and three harvests of describing; harmony, they said, is either the tune at the far field or the reason you learned to describe. They said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ harmony I remember is the harmony described in the record, which closed in 1985 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Harmony, my mother said in 1987, is the only peace that improves by being described; all harmony, she said, is a balance that has agreed to look like a peace. She said the balance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 和谐；融洽（指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 和谐；融洽（指那种和睦本身，与寂静相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a harmony 保持一份和谐
D. n. 和谐（指留给孩子们学着守的那一式）
E. n. 协调（抽象总称，指一处山谷的和谐之事）
F. n. 和谐（指记录里写到、被记下的那一式）
G. n. 和声；协调（指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 和声（抽象总称，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept a harmony that no stranger in the valley would have described
The harmony, meaning the peace itself and not the silence
Every kind of harmony in that valley
the harmony at the far field
the harmony was the whole of the matter
the harmony had become a line in a record
The harmony of the whole thing

answers.why: keep a harmony 意为“保持一份和谐”，1978 年那个村庄保持了山谷中没有一位陌生人肯描述的一份和睦。
harmony 意为“和谐、融洽”，指那种和睦本身而不是寂静，它经过了三个收获季而在簿子上没有被描述。
harmony 意为“和谐、融洽”，指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一首矮矮的歌。
harmony 意为“和谐”，指最远那片田里留给孩子们学着守的那一式，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
harmony 意为“和声、协调”，指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份协调就是那件事的全部。
harmony 意为“和声”，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份和睦，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
harmony 意为“和谐”，指记录里写到、被记下的那一式，到 1983 年这一式成了记录里的一行。
harmony 意为“协调”，村庄十一月写道，整件事的和谐之事是一处山谷和三个收获季的描述。
harmony 意为“和谐”，我记得的是记录里描述过的那一式，1985 年达成了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一份。
harmony 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，和谐是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的和睦。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1978 年那个村庄保持了山谷中没有一位陌生人肯描述的一份和睦，他们说守和才是那个收获季的全部。（keep a harmony）
那份和睦，指的是那种和睦本身而不是寂静，经过了三个收获季而在簿子上没有被描述。（harmony）
那处山谷里每一种和谐旁边都有同一首矮矮的歌。（harmony）
最远那片田里那支曲调，指的是他们留给孩子们学着唱的那一支，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（harmony）
叔叔说这份协调就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那份和睦。（harmony）

answers: In 1978 the village kept a harmony that no stranger in the valley would have described, and they said the keeping was the whole of the harvest.
The harmony, meaning the peace itself and not the silence, ran three harvests and stayed undescribed in the book.
Every kind of harmony in that valley had the same short song beside it.
The harmony at the far field, meaning the tune they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the harmony was the whole of the matter, meaning the balance and not the peace.
